steps.clue: Power the Hatchery generator with a Valkyrie Drone.
Solve the six valves and retrieve the Master Code Cylinder.
Insert the cylinder and enter KRONOS into S.O.P.H.I.A.
Place the six trophies beneath S.O.P.H.I.A.’s monitor.
Complete the first five trophy challenges.
Use the keycard to complete the Group 935 download in the Hatchery.
Collect the power core from S.O.P.H.I.A. and deliver it to Nikolai’s mech.
Enter the sewer beneath S.O.P.H.I.A. to reach the boss arena.
Defeat the dragon, then destroy Nikolai’s mech.
